# drive — Google Drive for your AI agents

These wiki pages copy the [`docs/` folder](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/drive-cli/tree/main/docs) on
every change to `main`, so an edit made here is overwritten. To fix a page, open a pull request against
`docs/`. The same guide is on [wirecat.dev](https://wirecat.dev/en/docs/drive); start with the
[README](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/drive-cli#readme).

Questions and ideas: [Discussions](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/drive-cli/discussions). What changed:
the [changelog](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/drive-cli/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) — there is no npm
release yet. `drive` is part of [WireCat](https://wirecat.dev).
